product_one_liner.value: Matillion provides cloud data integration and ETL tools that help data teams build, orchestrate, and manage pipelines to prepare data for analytics and AI.
product_one_liner.notes: Company describes an intelligent data integration platform for data teams.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists Developer, Teams, and Scale plans and explains consumption-based pricing, although it does not provide exact amounts.

named_customers.notes: Names appear on the customer stories page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company profile reports company size of 201–500 employees; narrower employee estimates are not needed for the requested band.

hq_location.notes: The company describes itself as dual headquartered in Denver and Manchester.

founded_year.notes: About page says Matillion has empowered data teams since 2011.

eng_blog.notes: Index includes technical articles on architecture and product infrastructure (among other content), with multiple qualifying technical posts.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation sites provide guides, API documentation, tutorials, and product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current listings include Senior Staff AI Engineer and Computer Science Industrial Placement – Software Engineering with AI.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed Matillion's AI information page, public documentation and available AI/security information; no provider is publicly identified as the provider used by the product. References to optional LLM integrations or examples do not establish the provider used by Maia.

compliance_certs.notes: The cited security page specifically names SOC 2 and ISO 27001; trust-center results additionally list PCI DSS. HIPAA and GDPR were not substantiated, so omitted.

last_funding.notes: The announcement states $150 million Series E funding on September 15, 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round was in September 2021, before the 18-month period beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current listings include Sales Development Representative and Enterprise Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: News index reports the launch of Maia Foundation on Google BigQuery on 2026-11-08, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Matillion announced CEO Girish Pancha and CDO Sanjay Krishnamurthi on 2026-08-04; Tim O’Neil was also appointed CRO in March 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Both systems appear as supported data connectors. This establishes visible integration support, not necessarily their use internally as Matillion's CRM.
